cover_letter_text:
Hi Synergia team,

I'm Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'd like to start out as a civil draftsperson. Preparing civil documentation for residential and commercial jobs is the work I trained for.

During the course I drew roads, earthworks and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. Before that, on site in the Philippines, I was the one reviewing drawings against the work and doing site inspections.

I'd move to Adelaide and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa) and a full Victorian driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
advert_text:
About the role
Join Synergia Constructions in St Clair, SA, as a Civil Engineering Draftsperson preparing accurate civil engineering and architectural documentation to support residential, commercial and civil construction projects.
Key responsibilities
- Prepare detailed civil engineering and architectural documentation for residential, commercial and civil construction projects.
- Develop and update technical drawings, plans and documentation in line with project requirements.
- Collaborate with engineers, architects, project managers and construction teams to coordinate design information.
- Undertake periodical site inspections to make sure site works adhere to documentations and project requirements.
- Review documentation for accuracy, consistency and compliance with relevant standards and project specifications.
- Manage drawing revisions and maintain organised project documentation.
What we're looking for
- Experience preparing civil engineering or architectural documentation.
- Proficiency with relevant computer-aided design and drafting software.
- Strong understanding of technical drawings, plans and construction documentation.
- High attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work.
- Effective communication and collaboration skills.
- The ability to manage priorities and meet project deadlines.
